execution.progress: One phase per paid round; the work, reserved material, damage, products and pinned striker and support persist; the same action continues it, resume restarts a pause after rechecks.

details.costs: Study: 3 rounds. target: your own unreserved, untreated item of a material with a represented casing (closed for crack modes, cracked unseparated for separate); quantity: exact tenths, 0.1-1 (default all, up to 1), reserved in one work (workId). Crack modes need striker (your own whole, rigid, sound inedible piece, e.g. a stone) and support (a solid inedible object in reach, not a plant or animal, or another own piece on firm ground), pinned for the work. Per 0.1 block: one cracking round, 1 energy; in crack-and-separate a block that opens adds one separation round, 0.5 energy; separate: one hand round, 0.5 energy per block. 0.9 units: at most 18 rounds, 13.5 energy. quoteOnly true reports quantity, striker condition, phases, maximum energy and wear bounds at no cost. pause, resume, cancel: one round, no energy. Checks run before any charge; failed rechecks pause open work at no charge. Travel and getting a striker are separate actions.
details.effects: Strength is hardness / 10; an impact passes the lower of striker and support strength x (1 - flexibility). At or below the casing strength the casing is unchanged: a real paid result that ends the work, the material returns as it was. Above it a block gains damage (load - strength) / strength: below 1 closed and damaged (a reattempt is new work), at 1 fractured open. Separation takes an opened block apart into 0.1 loose kernel and 0.1 casing fragments (a unit of each is that part of one whole unit) with the source origin, age and decay; the kernel carries all food value and toxicity, whatever they are. Opened blocks not separated stay cracked unseparated material. Wear: a striker no harder than what it strikes, or a support softer by 0.5 than what presses on it, loses 0.0001 kg per contact. Cancel returns reserved material as it now is; death leaves it at the worksite. Nothing is refunded, made safe or eaten; edibility, nutrition and toxins stay unknown; no reward.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. An entry marked inRetrieval is shown with at least the same content under the same id in this input's retrieval. Work records marked settled are completed, stopped or cancelled and show only identity, ability, mode, status, target, products and last payment; an exact state query with the same key returns the complete record. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.

value.name: Shape and use a wooden digging tool
value.function: Rub the end of your own wooden piece, such as a branch, into a blunt digging point on a hard rough surface, then use it to lever small amounts of loose surface soil out of a patch within reach.
value.costs: Study: 4 rounds. inspect: 1 round, 0.5 energy; target an own wooden item or tool and/or x, y a soil point in reach. shape: target an own unreserved rigid wooden item; quantity in tenths (default the item, at most 1 unit, one piece); abrasive: a rigid inedible noncombustible surface in reach, e.g. a rock, or your own whole piece of it on firm ground; both pinned to one work (workId). Each stroke: 1 round, 1 energy; at most 4 per segment; resume continues paused work. maintain: the same strokes on your own shaped or broken tool. use: target your shaped tool; x, y a soil point in reach; load 0.05-1 (default 0.25); 1 round, 1 energy. quoteOnly true quotes shape or maintain free. pause, resume, cancel: no energy. Refusals cost nothing; failed rechecks pause work free. Travel and getting a stone are separate.
value.effects: A whole branch unit is a 0.04 m by 0.99 m green-wood rod; a piece is that part of it. A stroke is 100 passes; by the scratch rule a surface no harder than the other loses 0.0001 kg per pass, so the end loses up to 0.01 kg as dust beside you (piece plus dust equals input). The end tapers over 3 diameters; release needs a tip at most 0.35 diameter and a 0.3 m shaft (a whole branch: about 7 strokes). A shaped tool is unverified until a stroke moves soil. A use stroke presses and levers 30 times at load x 500 N: the tip enters forest or meadow soil until the soil resistance (higher when drier) bears it and moves up to 0.001 m3 of the patch's loose top 0.15 m into a heap beside it; rock, wet bank, waterlogged soil and water move 0. Ground contact wears 0.0001 kg off the tip. Above strength (hardness/10, half if split) the end splits, then breaks. Cancel returns the piece as it is; death leaves it at the worksite. No edge, fire, water, binding, gathering bonus or reward.

execution.progress: One stroke per paid round, at most 4 per segment; the work, the reserved piece, its end and the pinned abrasive persist.
